description: This file defines the RestJsonParser class, which implements REST-JSON parsing logic for AWS services, specifically handling JSON payloads in HTTP responses within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: RestJsonParser
classes.description: Implements REST-JSON parsing for AWS SDK, handling JSON payloads from HTTP responses with support for payload extraction and member parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RestJsonParser instance with a given AWS service description and optional JSON parser.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the JSON payload from an HTTP response into a result array for a specific structure shape.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a JSON member from a stream response, returning the parsed result or an empty array.
